procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of question blocks on the renders of pdf 32-34 (4 + 4 + 3 + 4 + 2 + 2 = 19) and of answer-side keys 1-19 (pdf 108); the BLUE PRINT total 10+7+3 = 20 disagrees (FINDING, addendum §8)

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-19 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-4, II 5-8, III 9-11, IV 12-15, V 16-17, VI 18-19); answer side keys 1-19 in order. BLUE PRINT total 20 (10/7/3) disagrees with the audited 19 -> quota_table 'inconsistent', independent count as second method (addendum §8; finding, not a stop). Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 19.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 32 (heading, LO 5, BLUE PRINT, q1-4) 33 (q5-15) 34 (q16-19). A side 'Key Answers :- 7. Our Kitchen' pdf 108 (keys 1-19). Folios = pdf page.
BILINGUAL: all Kannada dropped (Unicode both sides; keys print the Kannada glued after the English — cut off).

Sections: s1 I odd-one-out q1-4 -> mcq (each question prints only its four lettered options and an answer line '------'; text = the section instruction + the printed option row, which is the whole printed question (answer dashes removed, kept in text_as_printed); options also split A-D); s2 II match q5-8 (numbered rows -> one-pair match questions); s3 III q9-11 (printed blanks -> fill); s4 IV q12-15; s5 V q16-17; s6 VI q18-19. All IV-VI keys are one line/list -> vsa by form.
MARKS (R-E9): s1 '4X1=4' -> 1; s2 '4x1=4' -> 1; s3 '3X1=3' -> 1; s4 '4X2=8' -> 2; s5 '2 X 3=6' and s6 '2 X 4=8' (2 q each) -> null, M is not the smaller factor (R-E9 as written).
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. LO (R-E10): lesson LO 5, lo_source 'lesson_table' (text joined from the LO row's two printed lines).

KEYS: MCQ keys print letter + text with a dot or comma ('1 D. Cooker.', '2. A, stone') -> option by the printed letter; all agree. Match key 6 wording variant flagged. q11 key 'Guarding the barricade' does not name chapati equipment (the key's Kannada line names rolling pin and griddle) -> 'key text does not address question' (review-blocking). q12 key 'children favourite food.' is an open-answer placeholder, kept verbatim. q18 asks for 5 things; key lists 4 — kept, unflagged.
FIGURES: none on these pages. TOPIC evs-3-07-t00 / chapter / high (R-E3).
